definitions.short: Jaazanjah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H2970. Yaazanyahu or Yaazanyah יַאֲזַנְיָ֫הוּ proper name, masculine ( Yahweh heareth ) — so 2Kin 25:23 ; Ezek 8:11 ; יַאֲזַנְיָה Jer 35:3 ; Ezek 11:1 ; contracted (וִ)יזַנְיָהוּ Jer 40:8 , (וִ)יזַנְיָה 42:1 — 1 a JudÊan 2 Kings 25:33; Jer 40:8 . 2 an elder of Israel, son of Shaphan Ezek 8:11 . 3 son of Jeremiah Jer 35:3 . 4 a leading JudÊan, son of Azur Ezek 11:1 . 5 a leading JudÊan Jer 42:1 (= עֲזַרְיָה 43:2 ).
definitions.rootNote: or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ ; from 238 and 3050 ; heard of Jah;
